summary: Dental hygienist with over sixteen years of clinical experience in general and periodontal hygiene care, serving patients of all ages, including medically compromised individuals. Background includes prophylaxis, periodontal assessment and maintenance, soft tissue management, digital and conventional radiography, and oral cancer screening. Also experienced in patient counseling on nutrition, smoking cessation, and preventative care, and in educating patients and dental staff on oral health. Earlier experience as a dental assistant covered chairside assisting, instrument sterilization, and front-office scheduling. Holds a Florida dental hygiene license and a master's degree in health sciences.
